source: Authorized no-op multipart write/read round trip on /dev/hidraw10
notes: Captured by running ObinsKit's native addon with its data reader active under strace. multi_package_create receives the 61 keycodes and one-byte layer prefix as separate vectors. USB limit 0x35 minus prefix length gives 52 keycodes per packet, and the layer prefix is repeated in both packets: layer+52, then layer+9. Both ACK payloads are success status 00 rather than packet indices. Native readback matched all 61 original bytes.
